County location data attribution

AreaCity-JsSpider-StatsGov, release 2025.251231.260403 (2026-04-03)

Taiwan township polygons: Taiwan-GeoJSON by titaneric, sourced from
Ministry of the Interior administrative boundary data.
https://github.com/titaneric/Taiwan-GeoJSON
Government open data source and terms:
https://data.gov.tw/dataset/7441
The mirror repository does not provide an explicit standalone license.

Supplementary Hekang, He'an and Cenling county boundaries:
Copyright OpenStreetMap contributors; Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0.
https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/
Retrieved through Nominatim on 2026-10-21; corresponding static source
queries and derived-file hashes are recorded in data/regions-source.json.

Coordinate normalization, binary indexing and local lookup code were
implemented in this project. These geographic facts are provided as a
versioned snapshot, not as an assertion of perpetual administrative currency.
